play: Integration and modernization behind the 2030 digital margin target
thesis: SLB told investors it is 'becoming a digital-first company'. It plans to double Digital to ~$2B ARR and lift EBITDA margin from ~26% to 38-42% by 2030, while integrating ChampionX, Tachyus and the S&P Global upstream software portfolio and certifying ~200 marketplace products. That margin gap is mostly about engineering productivity. Devin closes it with parallel integration, modernization and certification work, as capacity for the teams building Lumi and Tela.

why_now.t: The 2030 Digital targets are public, and the margin has to rise by 12-16 points.
Q1 2026 Digital EBITDA margin fell to 26.1%.
Three acquired software stacks are being integrated now.
Q3 2026 results on Oct 23. Use the call commentary as a fresh trigger.

challenges.stated: Double Digital revenue and ARR to ~$2B, with a 38-42% EBITDA margin by 2030.
challenges.devin: Ship more product without growing R&D at the same rate. Devin output is measured against margin.
Use the CEO's phrase as the opener for the value story.

challenges.stated: Integrating ChampionX, Tachyus and the S&P Global upstream software into Delfi and Lumi.
challenges.devin: Parallel Devins for adapters, migrations and regression tests.

challenges.stated: Marketplace certification for security, interoperability and compatibility on ~200 products from 30+ partners.
challenges.devin: Code Scans and Security Swarm as a certification pipeline. Devin could also be a marketplace listing itself.

challenges.stated: Products must support multi-cloud, on-prem and edge deployment.
challenges.devin: Build, test and upgrade work across every deployment target, run in parallel.

challenges.stated: More than 120 Petrel plug-ins built on Ocean, a Microsoft-based framework.
challenges.devin: Windows machines for desktop-product testing and .NET modernization.

pain_chain.pain: The digital-first story and the 2030 margin commitment to investors.
Integration and modernization use up R&D capacity after $407M of workforce charges.
pain_chain.measure: Roadmap delivery; R&D as a share of revenue

pain_chain.level: L3 Delfi/Lumi platform and product engineering heads
pain_chain.pain: Three codebases, multi-cloud targets, and a plug-in compatibility burden.
.NET desktop debt, CVE toil, certification testing.

com.elevator: You've committed to doubling Digital and adding 12-16 margin points by 2030 while integrating three acquired software stacks. Devin gives your platform teams autonomous engineers for integration, modernization and certification work, so you ship more without hiring at the same rate.
before: Senior engineers tied up integrating acquisitions
Petrel and Ocean .NET modernization is slow and risky for plug-in compatibility
Certification and multi-cloud testing are bottlenecks
negative: Margin target missed; ARR growth limited by capacity
Customers held back by compatibility breaks
Partners are slower to list on the marketplace
after: Integration work done in parallel with tests
Modernization done incrementally with compatibility suites
required: Protects IP and runs in isolated machines
Works alongside SLB's own agent frameworks
proof: Possible partnership: listing on the SLB marketplace
